subject: science
concept: Understanding the water cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Systems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes a simple sealed-container water cycle model over simulated time
exercise.pictorial: Student labels each stage of the water cycle on a diagram in the correct order
exercise.abstract: Student explains what happens at a described stage of the water cycle

misconception_flags: believes water disappears during evaporation rather than becoming vapor

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
